description: The agent's details and the words on her home page. One record feeds every page, so a change here shows across the site. Fields marked with language tabs have an English and a Spanish version: fill in both.

id.label: ID
id.help: Always info. The templates look for this record by its ID, so leave it alone.

name.label: Agent Name
name.help: Her full name, as it appears in the nav, the footer and search results.

signature.label: Signature
signature.help: The word shown in script over the hero photo and in the footer, usually just her first name.

photo.label: Portrait
photo.help: Her headshot, used in the home page hero (an arched crop) and on the About page. A tall photo works best.

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.help: One short line under her name in the footer, e.g. Real estate on the Peninsula, with care.

heroHeadline.label: Hero Headline
heroHeadline.help: The large line on the home page. Keep it short: a few words. The Hero Accent follows it in italic rosewood.

heroAccent.label: Hero Accent
heroAccent.help: The last few words of the headline, set in italic rosewood, e.g. feels like home.

heroLede.label: Hero Introduction
heroLede.help: Two sentences under the headline: who she helps and where.

bio.label: Biography
bio.help: Her story for the About page. A few short paragraphs, in her own voice.

languages.label: Languages Spoken
languages.help: Shown on the About page, e.g. English and Spanish.

phone.label: Phone
phone.help: Shown in the footer and on the Contact page. Use her direct mobile, the one she answers.

email.label: Email
email.help: Shown in the footer. Form submissions are emailed here too, once the site's mail settings are set up.

address.label: Office Address
address.help: Street on the first line, then City, ST 12345 on the second.

license.label: License Line
license.help: Her license, exactly as her state requires it to appear, e.g. DRE #01234567. Shown in the footer of every page.

brokerage.label: Brokerage
brokerage.help: The brokerage she works under. Many states require it on every page, so it's in the footer.

brokerageLogo.label: Brokerage Logo
brokerageLogo.help: Optional. A small logo for the footer. Leave it empty and the footer shows the name only.

yearsInBusiness.label: Years in Real Estate
yearsInBusiness.help: Shown on the About page. Leave it at 0 to hide it.

sellerTitle.label: Seller Callout Title (A)
sellerTitle.help: Version A of the home page's seller callout, the headline. The A/B test shows half of visitors version A and half version B.

sellerText.label: Seller Callout Text (A)
sellerText.help: Version A's sentence under the headline.

sellerTitleB.label: Seller Callout Title (B)
sellerTitleB.help: Version B of the seller callout, the headline. Version B shows the callout near the top of the home page. See /readme for how to read the results.

sellerTextB.label: Seller Callout Text (B)
sellerTextB.help: Version B's sentence under the headline.

privateTitle.label: Private List Title
privateTitle.help: The headline of the private-list callout and page, e.g. The private list.

privateText.label: Private List Text
privateText.help: What a buyer gets for signing up: they see coming-soon homes before anyone else.

mortgageRate.label: Mortgage Rate (%)
mortgageRate.help: The interest rate the mortgage calculator starts with, e.g. 6.25. Visitors can change it. Update it now and then.

propertyTaxRate.label: Property Tax Rate (%)
propertyTaxRate.help: The yearly property tax the calculator assumes, as a percent of the price. About 1.1 on the Peninsula.

insuranceYearly.label: Home Insurance per Year ($)
insuranceYearly.help: The yearly insurance estimate the calculator adds.

social.label: Social Links
social.help: Her social profiles, shown as links in the footer. Add or remove as she likes.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the object is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the object is created.
